metadata.description: Central ecosystem catalog of Thorlan04 autonomous B2B Actors, MCP servers, and GitHub technical hubs.

apify_actors.name: EU B2B Compliance & AI-Readiness Auditor
apify_actors.headline: Enterprise-grade legal SIREN/SIRET/VAT, GDPR, EAA 2025 & llms.txt compliance auditor for European B2B companies.
apify_actors.description: Autonomous AI auditor built for B2B intelligence. Inspects websites and registries to verify official SIREN, SIRET, and European VIES intra-community VAT numbers. Audits GDPR legal mentions, cookie consent management (CMP), European Accessibility Act (EAA 2025 / WCAG 2.1 AA) compliance, and evaluates machine-readability through an AI-Readiness score (llms.txt, Schema.org JSON-LD). Available as native Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool for Claude Desktop, Cursor, n8n, and Make.
key_features: Official French SIREN/SIRET validation & European VIES VAT verification
GDPR compliance audit (privacy policy, cookie banner, DPO disclosure)
European Accessibility Act (EAA June 2025) and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance scan
AI-Readiness scoring engine (llms.txt presence, semantic meta tags, JSON-LD)
Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) stream and JSON-LD structured report
Seamless webhook integration for n8n, Make.com, Zapier, and LangChain
use_cases: B2B sales qualification and automated lead scoring
Supplier and vendor KYC / legal risk screening
Web agency compliance pre-audit and client reporting
Autonomous LLM agents requiring certified company verification
intent_keywords: check SIRET SIREN VAT VIES online

mcp_tool_declaration.name: audit_eu_b2b_compliance
mcp_tool_declaration.description: Audits a European company website for legal compliance (SIREN, SIRET, VAT VIES), GDPR privacy standards, EAA 2025 accessibility, and AI-Readiness (llms.txt).

targetUrl.description: The URL of the company website to audit (e.g. https://example.com).

checkVies.description: Whether to validate VAT numbers against official EU VIES registry.

checkEaa.description: Check European Accessibility Act (EAA 2025) compliance indicators.

apify_actors.name: Shopify Fast Catalog & Products JSON Monitor
apify_actors.headline: Ultra-fast Shopify store crawler and pricing tracker extracting product catalogs via public JSON feeds.
apify_actors.description: High-velocity, zero-proxy scraper designed specifically for Shopify storefronts. Leverages public `/products.json` and collection endpoints to retrieve product titles, handles, variant IDs, live stock status, real-time pricing, SKUs, barcode numbers, image galleries, and category tags at maximum speed. Perfect for dynamic repricing bots, competitor monitoring, RAG vector database ingestion, and stock alert automation.
key_features: Extracts complete Shopify catalogs without costly rotating residential proxies
Extracts detailed variants, inventory status, prices, SKUs, and compare-at prices
Pagination automation handling stores with over 100,000+ products
Export directly to JSON, CSV, Excel, XML, or streaming MCP output
Instant webhook triggers when price drops or new inventory is detected
Lightweight footprint engineered for real-time AI Agent execution
use_cases: Competitor price tracking and dynamic price optimization
Dropshipping catalog synchronization and trending product discovery
Feeding e-commerce vector search and RAG knowledge bases
Stock depletion alerts and restock notification automations
intent_keywords: Shopify MCP tool for AI agents

mcp_tool_declaration.name: scrape_shopify_catalog_json
mcp_tool_declaration.description: Crawls and extracts full product catalogs, variants, prices, and stock levels from any public Shopify store using high-speed JSON feeds.

shopifyStoreUrl.description: Base URL of the target Shopify store (e.g. https://store.example.com).

maxProducts.description: Maximum number of products to extract.

collection.description: Optional specific collection handle to scrape.

apify_actors.name: Apify B2B Autopilot Pack
apify_actors.headline: Autonomous B2B intelligence suite for LLM web-to-markdown extraction, llms.txt generation, and multi-store retail tracking.
apify_actors.description: The ultimate autonomous suite for modern AI agents and B2B developers. Combines automated LLM-optimized Markdown web extraction, automated llms.txt generator for generative search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude), multi-brand Shopify catalog monitoring, and European B2B compliance scanning into a unified workflow. Ready to plug into n8n, Make, Flowise, LangChain, and Claude Desktop via native MCP.
key_features: Clean, noise-free Markdown extraction tuned for RAG embeddings and LLM context windows
Automatic generation of llms.txt and llms-full.txt files according to current AI standards
Unified access to legal compliance audits and e-commerce tracking
Zero-infrastructure execution hosted on Apify's scalable cloud
Direct MCP protocol bridge for Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, and LangChain
use_cases: Autonomous market research and competitor surveillance agents
Website modernization and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
Automated RAG knowledge base building for enterprise chatbots
Workflow automation pipelines in n8n, Make, and Zapier

mcp_tool_declaration.name: execute_b2b_autopilot_pipeline
mcp_tool_declaration.description: Runs comprehensive B2B pipeline: extracts clean Markdown, analyzes compliance, monitors e-commerce catalogs, and generates llms.txt manifests.

targetUrl.description: Target website URL for extraction, compliance audit, or catalog monitoring.
